plugins.prepareCmd: uv run python -c "import re; p='pyproject.toml'; t=open(p).read(); open(p,'w').write(re.sub(r'version = \"[^\"]*\"', 'version = \"${nextRelease.version}\"', t, count=1))" && uv run python -m pygrowthstandards.data.main

plugins.successComment: 🎉 ${issue.pull_request ? 'PR is included in version ' + nextRelease.version : 'Issue has been resolved in version ' + nextRelease.version}. The release is available on [GitHub release](${releases})
